title: Architecture
lead: One frame is one Docker Compose, and its outline hugs exactly the containers inside it. Thick lines join Compose to Compose, thin lines join container to container, and every line is a dial written in a compose file, a toml, nginx, or a Traefik route.
hint: Dev comes first. Secure follows the slash. The same port on two NAS machines does not collide, because the IP differs.
gridLead: One block per repo, padded to a port ending in 9. Solid is used, hatched is reserved.
clickHint: Hover a container to light its links. Tick containers, or the box at a frame's bottom-right, to keep every link of the selection. Drag a header to move, drag an edge to resize, double-click to focus a Compose.
servicesLead: Hover a container to light it on the canvas. Tick containers one by one, or tick a Compose's corner box to select all of it.
lineLabel: Show Compose lines or container lines
focusAction: Focus this Compose and show its container lines

frame-traefik.title: NFX-Edge Traefik
frame-traefik.body: The reverse proxy on its own Compose file. File routes in dynamic/*.project.yml dial NAS_IP plus the host port. 80/443 stays out of the 10000 blocks.

frame-identity.title: NFX-Identity
frame-identity.body: Login, profiles, and assets. Every other product dials auth-base over gRPC, and every console proxies to auth and asset.

frame-news.title: NFX-News
frame-news.body: Six backends and a console. mcp, crawl, and report also dial each other over gRPC.

frame-storages.title: NFX-Storages
frame-storages.body: Five backends and a console. Object bytes live on NAS volumes, not in Stack MinIO. s3 is reached by Host route, not through the console.

frame-edge.title: NFX-Edge
frame-edge.body: sites-base owns certificates and sites. ACME still goes through Traefik on port 80.

frame-static.title: Static sites
frame-static.body: Not a Compose. Each start.sh builds the image and runs one container with docker run.

frame-stack.title: NFX-Stack
frame-stack.body: Shared data plane made of ten Compose files. Products dial NAS_IP plus these host ports. There is no shared Docker network.

frame-stack-mysql.title: MySQL
frame-stack-mysql.body: MySQL and phpMyAdmin. The UI reaches the database by its Compose service name.

frame-stack-mongodb.title: MongoDB
frame-stack-mongodb.body: MongoDB and mongo-express. The UI reaches the database by its Compose service name.

frame-stack-postgresql.title: PostgreSQL
frame-stack-postgresql.body: Every NFX backend keeps its database here. pgAdmin only depends on it; servers are added by hand.

frame-stack-redis.title: Redis
frame-stack-redis.body: Cache for every NFX backend. RedisInsight only depends on it; the connection is added by hand.

frame-stack-kafka.title: Kafka
frame-stack-kafka.body: Event bus for every NFX backend. Products use the EXTERNAL listener; Kafka UI uses kafka:9092.

frame-stack-rabbitmq.title: RabbitMQ
frame-stack-rabbitmq.body: AMQP and the management UI in one container. No NFX product dials it today.

frame-stack-minio.title: MinIO
frame-stack-minio.body: S3 API and console in one container. Identity asset-base stores images here, and Traefik serves the public bucket path.

frame-stack-centrifugo.title: Centrifugo
frame-stack-centrifugo.body: Realtime server. No NFX product dials it today.

frame-stack-otel.title: OpenTelemetry
frame-stack-otel.body: The collector takes OTLP from every backend, sends traces to Jaeger and logs to Loki, and exposes metrics for Prometheus. Grafana reads all three.

frame-stack-opensearch.title: OpenSearch
frame-stack-opensearch.body: OpenSearch and its Dashboards. No NFX product dials it today.

internet.title: Internet
internet.body: The public network only sees the router.

router.title: Router
router.body: Forwards only 80 and 443 to the NAS that runs Traefik.

nas2.title: NAS2
nas2.body: The same Compose files and port numbers. Traefik only swaps the IP in the URL.

traefik.title: Traefik
traefik.body: Routes every backend, console, MinIO, and static site by path or host.

identity-auth.title: Identity auth
identity-auth.body: Accounts, sessions, and profiles. Sends mail through SMTP.

identity-asset.title: Identity asset
identity-asset.body: Uploads and images. Stores objects in MinIO and checks tokens with auth.

identity-console.title: Identity console
identity-console.body: nginx serves the build and proxies /nfx-identity/auth and /nfx-identity/asset.

news-crawl.title: News crawl
news-crawl.body: Crawl sessions. Dials source and report over gRPC.

news-report.title: News report
news-report.body: Keyword DSL and snapshots. Dials news over gRPC.

news-notify.title: News notify
news-notify.body: Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram webhooks. Consumes nfxnews.report from Kafka.

news-mcp.title: News MCP
news-mcp.body: Tool list and calls. Dials news, report, source, and crawl over gRPC.

news-console.title: News console
news-console.body: nginx serves the build and proxies the six News backends plus Identity.

storages-s3.title: Storages S3
storages-s3.body: Go S3 on Host s3.nebulaforgex.com. Object bytes live on the NAS volumes, not in Stack MinIO.

storages-admin.title: Storages admin
storages-admin.body: Every browser route under /admin/v3: users, policies, KMS, and more.

storages-object.title: Storages object
storages-object.body: Object module. Its HTTP routes are empty, so the browser goes through admin.

storages-iam.title: Storages IAM
storages-iam.body: IAM authorize. Its HTTP routes are empty, so the browser goes through admin.

storages-notify.title: Storages notify
storages-notify.body: Event targets. Its HTTP routes are empty, so the browser goes through admin.

storages-console.title: Storages console
storages-console.body: nginx serves the build and proxies admin, object, iam, notify, and Identity.

edge-sites.title: Edge sites
edge-sites.body: Sites and certificates. Answers ACME challenges behind Traefik.

edge-console.title: Edge console
edge-console.body: nginx serves the build and proxies sites and Identity.

documentation-frontend.title: Docs frontend
documentation-frontend.body: This handbook. nginx inside listens on port 80.

aquaworks.title: AquaWorks
aquaworks.body: Static site. The LAN path redirects to this port.

timetable.title: TimetableCraft
timetable.body: Static site. The LAN path redirects to this port.

stack-postgresql.title: PostgreSQL
stack-postgresql.body: One database per product, for example nfxidentity and nfxnews.

stack-kafka.title: Kafka
stack-kafka.body: KRaft broker. PLAINTEXT kafka:9092 inside, EXTERNAL on the host port.

stack-minio.title: MinIO
stack-minio.body: S3 API on 9000 and the console on 9001.

stack-otel-collector.title: Otel Collector
stack-otel-collector.body: OTLP in. Traces to Jaeger, logs to Loki, metrics on 8889.
